mainEntity.name: When should we choose a Force Urbania over a Tempo Traveller?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choose Urbania for senior travellers, longer km days (>325 km), corporate comfort, improved stability & reduced fatigue.

mainEntity.name: How many people fit comfortably in an Urbania for multi-day circuits?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ideal comfort band: 8–12 passengers depending on configuration with room for soft bags & cushions.

mainEntity.name: Is Urbania fuel cost higher than a standard Tempo Traveller?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes—the per km rate (₹34–35) is higher vs ₹24–27 but per head uplift is modest on longer circuits.

mainEntity.name: Does Urbania have better suspension for rough patches?

acceptedAnswer.text: Long wheelbase + tuned suspension + wider stance provide smoother handling on patchy stretches.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth upgrading for a 1-day local Varanasi run?

acceptedAnswer.text: Usually no unless VIP protocol, branding requirement or senior comfort priority.
